import copy
import unittest
from solution import find_notices


class FindNoticesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.principal = {"authenticated": True}
        self.notices = [
            {"id": "1", "district": "North", "locality": "Lake", "department": "Parks", "arrangement": "Public", "published": True, "meta": {"tags": ["a"]}},
            {"id": "2", "district": "North", "locality": "Lake", "department": "Roads", "arrangement": "Public", "published": False},
            {"id": "3", "district": "North", "locality": "Lake", "department": "Parks", "arrangement": "Private", "published": True},
            {"id": "4", "district": "north", "locality": "Lake", "department": "Parks", "arrangement": "Public", "published": True},
        ]

    def test_filtering_order_duplicates_and_optional_filters(self):
        duplicate = copy.deepcopy(self.notices[0])
        notices = tuple(self.notices + [duplicate])
        result = find_notices(
            notices,
            self.principal,
            district="North",
            locality="Lake",
            department="Parks",
            arrangement="Public",
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result], ["1", "1"])
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["id"] for item in find_notices(self.notices, self.principal, district="North", locality="Lake")],
            ["1", "3"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["id"] for item in find_notices(self.notices, self.principal, district="North", locality="Lake", department="Parks")],
            ["1", "3"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["id"] for item in find_notices(self.notices, self.principal, district="North", locality="Lake", arrangement="Private")],
            ["3"],
        )

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(find_notices([], self.principal, district="X", locality="Y"), [])
        self.assertEqual(find_notices((), self.principal, district="X", locality="Y"), [])

    def test_authentication_must_be_exact_true(self):
        for principal in ({}, {"authenticated": False}, {"authenticated": 1}, None, []):
            with self.subTest(principal=principal):
                with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
                    find_notices([], principal, district="X", locality="Y")

    def test_all_required_notice_fields_are_validated(self):
        valid = self.notices[0]
        required_text = ("id", "district", "locality", "department", "arrangement")
        invalid_cases = ["not a sequence", [42]]
        invalid_cases.extend([{k: v for k, v in valid.items() if k != field}] for field in required_text + ("published",))
        invalid_cases.extend([[{**valid, field: 7}]] for field in required_text)
        invalid_cases.extend([[{**valid, "published": value}]] for value in (1, "yes", None))
        invalid_cases.append([valid, {**valid, "district": 7}])

        for notices in invalid_cases:
            with self.subTest(notices=notices):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    find_notices(notices, self.principal, district="North", locality="Lake")

    def test_results_are_deep_copies_and_arguments_are_unchanged(self):
        original = copy.deepcopy(self.notices)
        result = find_notices(
            self.notices,
            self.principal,
            district="North",
            locality="Lake",
            department="Parks",
            arrangement="Public",
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.notices, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], self.notices[0])

        result[0]["meta"]["tags"].append("result")
        self.assertEqual(self.notices[0]["meta"]["tags"], ["a"])
        self.notices[0]["meta"]["tags"].append("input")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["meta"]["tags"], ["a", "result"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
